messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "controlled studies have been limited to 12 months of therapy"
set: ["controlled studies have been limited to 12 months of therapy", "weight loss increases over 6 to 12 months", "blood tests performed every 6 to 12 months once dose is stable", "6 to 12 weeks", "use of doses exceeding 225 mg/day is limited", "discard after 4 weekly doses have been given", "read and follow all instructions you have been given", "therapy should be withdrawn", "controlled room temperature is 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C)", "relief of itchy, watery eyes applies to ages 12 and older", "extended-release (XR), ages 6 to 12 years", "intravenous therapy should be discontinued as soon as the patient is able to resume oral therapy", "allow at least 4 months to pass before starting new 14-day course of treatment", "consult doctor if having trouble quitting after 7 to 12 weeks of use", "doses administered 12 hours apart", "doses spaced 12 hours apart"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
